definitions.gloss: medical history; past illness record; previous medical conditions
definitions.explanation: A record of a patient's past illnesses, surgeries, and medical conditions. Used in clinical settings when gathering patient information.

examples.japanese: {既往歴|きおうれき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please tell me your medical history.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問診票|もんしんひょう}→問診票：09708_monshinhyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{既往歴|きおうれき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I filled in my medical history on the patient questionnaire.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{既往歴|きおうれき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{詳|くわ}しく→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Before surgery, the doctor needs to check the patient's medical history in detail.

notes:
Composed of {既往|きおう} (past, previous) and {歴|れき} (history, record). This is the standard medical term used in hospitals and clinics throughout Japan. Patients encounter this word on ⟦{問診票|もんしんひょう}→問診票：09708_monshinhyou⟧ (patient questionnaires) that must be filled out before seeing a doctor for the first time.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {既往歴|きおうれき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧: to ask about medical history
- {既往歴|きおうれき}なし: no prior medical history
- {既往歴|きおうれき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{記載|きさい}→記載：14169_kisai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to record in medical history
- ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧{既往歴|きおうれき}: family medical history

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{病歴|びょうれき}→病歴：19429_byoureki⟧: medical history — more general and colloquial; {既往歴|きおうれき} is the formal clinical term
- {現病歴|げんびょうれき}: history of present illness — specifically about the current condition that brought the patient in
- ⟦{診察券|しんさつけん}→診察券：09709_shinsatsuken⟧: patient registration card — the physical card, not the medical record itself
